# Step - sum

`sum` · category: [Aggregation](../../traversal/step_reference.md#aggregation)

Yields the sum of the numbers in the stream (Scope.local: of each collection).

## Forms

```text
sum()
sum(arg1: Scope)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().values("age").sum().next()   // 123
```
